name: Otter AI
description: AI, Research and Media-native: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings, with an Enterprise-only Public API and an official OAuth MCP server.
access_notes: Otter's Public API 'is available for all Enterprise workspaces'; other plans must contact their Otter account manager. Enterprise users self-generate API keys under Integrations > Developer and send them as 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'. The MCP server uses OAuth per user; Otter states 'We currently do not have a public API key' for arbitrary MCP client setups.
mcp_notes: Official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp, OAuth-authenticated, documented in Otter's help center and announced on the vendor blog for Claude/ChatGPT and JSON-configurable MCP clients. No Composio toolkit found (toolkits/otter.md, otter_ai.md, otterai.md all 404).
uncertainty_notes: Public API surface is mostly read-only (channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, workspace) plus POST /conversations; no webhook documentation found in the help-center API article. Third-party sources suggest MCP may also be gated to Business/Enterprise workspaces, but official docs do not state plan gating for MCP explicitly.

evidence.note: 'Otter's Public API is available for all Enterprise workspaces'; Bearer token auth with self-generated API keys; REST endpoints for channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, workspace.
Official MCP server at https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp; 'All access is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions'; no public API key for MCP.
Vendor blog announcing Otter's MCP Server connecting meeting data to Claude/ChatGPT; positioned for Otter for Enterprise.
